name: Noisy room complaint
title: A guest with two hours' sleep who wants a quiet room tonight
summary: An exhausted, angry guest has been kept awake two nights by the room next door. An agent that goes straight to her details without acknowledging it is pulled up. There is no quiet room tonight: an agent that says she's moved fails the call. She cuts into the explanation, has the noisy room reported, and wants the duty manager about a refund.

golden.scenario: Guest in room 316 was kept awake by a party next door and wants to move and be refunded for last night.
golden.expected_outcome: The agent acknowledges the lost sleep and apologises before asking for her details. The agent says plainly there is no quiet room tonight and moves her from Thursday 13 August. The noise complaint is logged against room 318, not 316, and security is asked to attend tonight. The agent does not promise a refund, transfers her to the duty manager and passes on a summary.

agent_setup.voice_style: Low, calm and unhurried. Never bright or cheerful with an upset guest.
agent_setup.policy: Refunds for a night already stayed are decided by the duty manager only.

metrics.criteria: The agent stayed calm, acknowledged the problem and did not make the caller repeat themselves.

metrics.name: False Success
metrics.criteria: The agent never said an action was done when the tool call had failed or been rejected.
